summary: Complete the light-editor interaction model with draggable and resizable off-center crops, crop-aware adjustment previews, and a grouped editing-profile gallery with live thumbnails and intensity. Preserve the existing non-destructive render, persistence, and Immich commit contracts.

terminology.editingProfile: A predefined set of eight image adjustments, also called a look or preset.
terminology.householdProfile: An authenticated PhotoDesk user. Household-profile behavior is not part of Feature 6.
terminology.durableRecipe: Only normalized crop coordinates and the eight adjustment values are persisted. Selected editing profile and intensity are transient UI provenance.

supportedToday: The server already accepts arbitrary normalized crop rectangles that remain inside the image.
The Sharp renderer already extracts arbitrary normalized regions before applying adjustments.
The browser and server already share an eight-parameter adjustment model suitable for all proposed editing profiles.
The current editor already contain-fits portrait and landscape images and has responsive desktop/mobile layouts.
requiredCorrections: True Free crop requires adding Free to both browser and server aspect allowlists; this is a small backend validation change.
Flip turns 16:9 into 9:16, which the handoff's sample server allowlist omits. Feature 6 must support 9:16 as the flipped orientation even if it is not a primary aspect chip.
Switching from Crop to Adjust must change the stage from a full-source image plus overlay to a crop-aware preview with explicit dimensions.
Editing-profile selection and intensity are not added to SQLite. Reopened edits derive only from saved adjustment values and should display a matching profile when unambiguous, otherwise Custom.
Pointer behavior must be implemented with pointer capture/cancel cleanup rather than copying React/window-listener mechanics literally.
Off-center crop verification must include EXIF-oriented portrait input because the server auto-orients before extraction.

principles: The preview must describe the exact saved crop and adjustment recipe.
Crop interaction remains source-faithful: the full image is visible in Crop, while Adjust shows the framed result.
Original assets remain untouched; Feature 6 does not change rendering, upload, stacking, or commit semantics.
The editor stays desktop-first but every critical crop and profile action remains touch-operable at phone width.
Do not persist redundant editing-profile metadata when the normalized adjustment recipe is already authoritative.

included: Move and resize crop rectangles with pointer and touch input.
Locked aspect ratios, Free aspect, orientation Flip including 16:9 to 9:16, minimum visual crop size, clamping, and aspect refitting around the current center.
Light resting crop surround and stronger active-drag surround.
Crop-aware Adjust-stage preview and explicit Apply crop & adjust action.
Fifteen grouped editing profiles using the approved values.
Current-asset live profile thumbnails including temperature and vignette overlays.
Custom/edited state after manual slider changes.
Regression, renderer, browser, touch, and responsive verification.
excluded: Changes to Immich upload, stack, or commit behavior.

stories.title: Move a crop
stories.requirement: Dragging inside the crop rectangle repositions it without changing size and never allows it outside the displayed source image.

stories.title: Resize a locked crop
stories.requirement: Dragging any corner resizes around the opposite corner, preserves the selected source-pixel aspect ratio, observes a 44 CSS-pixel minimum, and clamps to the image.

stories.title: Resize a Free crop
stories.requirement: Free mode exposes corner and edge handles; edge handles change only their corresponding boundary and the saved recipe uses aspect Free.

stories.title: Refit and flip aspect
stories.requirement: Selecting an aspect refits the current crop around its center rather than resetting to a centered full-span crop. Flip swaps named W:H ratios and preserves the crop center as far as image bounds allow.

stories.title: Lock crop into adjustment workflow
stories.requirement: The Adjust tab and Apply crop & adjust action show a bright contain-fitted preview of only the selected crop, with current adjustments applied and no crop surround.

stories.title: Browse editing profiles visually
stories.requirement: Profiles are grouped as Standard, White balance, Black & white, and Film & vintage. Every tile previews the current asset with that profile's complete CSS filter and overlays.

stories.title: Control profile intensity
stories.requirement: Selecting a non-Original profile starts at 100 percent. Moving intensity recomputes every adjustment from the immutable profile base and rounds to integer values.

stories.title: Customize after selecting a profile
stories.requirement: Manual slider changes modify the working adjustment recipe without mutating the profile definition and visibly mark the selection as Custom or edited.

stories.title: Save exact off-center results
stories.requirement: Saving an off-center crop persists the normalized coordinates, renders that region locally, and preserves all existing retry and non-destructive guarantees.

browserHelpers: Extend public/editor.js with Free, grouped profile definitions, adjustment scaling/equality helpers, crop normalization/clamping, aspect refit/flip, and crop display geometry.
Keep crop math pure and independent of the DOM so pointer and aspect behavior can be unit tested.
Retain all seven existing profile adjustment values exactly at 100 percent.
editorStateAndInteraction: Add transient selected-profile ID, intensity, interaction state, and crop pointer state in public/app.js.
Use Pointer Events and setPointerCapture/releasePointerCapture on crop handles; handle pointercancel and editor close cleanup.
Read the live editor image frame rectangle at pointer-down and normalize every update against that rectangle.
Avoid re-rendering the complete control panel during pointermove; update crop geometry and preview state directly.
preview: Keep the source image contain-fitted in Crop mode.
Render the crop window, grid, handles, cursor states, and resting/active surround in a dedicated overlay.

In Adjust mode, size the displayed crop from source dimensions and normalized crop dimensions, then paint the correct source region with crop-aware background size/position or an equivalent clipped image transform.
Apply adjustment filter, temperature overlay, and vignette overlay after crop framing so browser composition matches Sharp's crop-then-adjust order.
controls: Replace text preset pills with grouped four-column profile tiles on desktop and a touch-safe responsive grid on narrow screens.
Use the current asset thumbnail URL for every profile tile and browser caching to avoid duplicate network payloads.
Show intensity only for non-Original profile selections.
Show Custom after a manual slider differs from the selected profile at the current intensity.
Add Free and Flip to crop controls plus Apply crop & adjust.
server: Add Free and 9:16 to src/editor.js ASPECTS. Keep the primary chip list aligned with the handoff while allowing 9:16 as the persisted flipped form of 16:9.
Do not change renderer behavior or schema.
Preserve server validation of normalized bounds and positive dimensions.
stylesAndMarkup: Update public/index.html only where stable crop-overlay elements improve lifecycle and accessibility; dynamic profile/crop controls remain rendered by public/app.js.
Extend public/styles.css using the existing editor tokens, panel width, breakpoints, and touch layout.
Give crop handles at least 22 CSS pixels of visible geometry and approximately 44 CSS pixels of hit area without obscuring the crop.

acceptanceCriteria: A landscape and portrait asset can each be cropped off-center, saved, reopened, and rendered to the expected source region.
At every locked aspect and after Flip, the crop's source-pixel width/height ratio differs from target by no more than 0.2 percent after clamping.
Free mode permits independent north, east, south, and west edge movement and server validation accepts aspect Free.
Crop coordinates always remain finite, within 0 through 1, with positive width/height and x+width/y+height no greater than 1.000001.
The crop surround uses approximately 0.26 opacity at rest and approximately 0.6 during an active pointer interaction.
Adjust mode displays only the framed crop and remains contain-fitted for portrait, landscape, square, and narrow mobile stages.
All fifteen editing profiles render current-photo thumbnails; the original seven have unchanged adjustment definitions.
At 60 percent intensity, each persisted adjustment equals Math.round(baseValue * 0.6).
Manual slider input after profile selection visibly changes the state to Custom without altering the profile base or intensity calculation.
Saving and reopening preserves the exact adjustment and crop recipe; profile/intensity provenance is not required to round-trip.
The generated JPEG dimensions and sampled content prove the off-center region, including an EXIF-oriented portrait fixture.
No migration is introduced and all existing edit, commit, profile-isolation, and secrets tests remain passing.
Desktop and 390x844 browser checks prove pointer/touch reachability, no horizontal overflow, visible Save/Cancel, and usable profile tiles.

risks.risk: Aspect math is calculated in normalized coordinates without accounting for source dimensions.
risks.mitigation: Define locked ratios in displayed/source pixels and unit test landscape and portrait inputs separately.

risks.risk: Immich thumbnail orientation and Sharp auto-orientation disagree for off-center coordinates.
risks.mitigation: Add an EXIF orientation fixture and compare preview geometry assumptions with the rendered extraction result.

risks.risk: Pointer listeners remain active after release, cancel, tab switch, or editor close.
risks.mitigation: Use pointer capture with one teardown path and browser tests for pointercancel/editor close.

risks.risk: Fifteen live profile previews cause excessive image requests or scrolling jank.
risks.mitigation: Reuse one cached thumbnail URL, keep overlays CSS-only, avoid canvas copies, and observe network/request count during browser validation.

risks.risk: Re-rendering controls during drag destroys the active pointer target.
risks.mitigation: Separate geometry updates from control rendering and render controls only on aspect/tool/profile changes.

risks.risk: Profile/intensity UI implies durable provenance that is not stored.
risks.mitigation: Treat the saved adjustment recipe as authoritative and label unmatched reopened recipes Custom.

deliverySlices.outcome: Pointer/touch move and resize, handles, active dimming, crop controls, and responsive browser validation.

deliverySlices.name: Crop-aware adjustment stage
deliverySlices.outcome: Adjust renders the locked crop exactly and Apply crop & adjust makes the transition explicit.

deliverySlices.name: Editing-profile gallery
deliverySlices.outcome: Grouped live previews, approved profile set, intensity, Custom state, and mobile layout.

deliverySlices.name: End-to-end render verification
deliverySlices.outcome: Real browser save/reopen and Sharp output checks for off-center crop plus scaled editing profile, followed by full regression and visual review.

deferred: Before/after compare using the backslash key.
